title: Filter Fresh Extended City
description: Per-city data file used by /pool-filter-cleaning/[slug]. One file per city in content/cities/<slug>.json. Files starting with an underscore or named cities.json are ignored by the loader.

slug.description: URL slug. Must match the filename (without .json).

tier.description: 1 = launch market, 2 = expansion, 3 = serviced on request.

median_home_value.description: USD. Source: any reasonable real-estate aggregate (Zillow ZHVI, Redfin).

pool_density_note.description: 1 to 2 sentences about pool ownership in this city. Avoid generic claims, prefer concrete observations (subdivision age, climate, lot size).

local_landmark.description: Real reference point: park, school, shopping center, historic district.

climate_note.description: Microclimate detail relevant to filter buildup. Pollen sources, dust events, marine air, salt corrosion, decomposed-granite landscaping, etc.
